definitions.explanation: A dish made by simmering ingredients over low heat for an extended time, allowing flavors to meld. Used both as a standalone noun for the dish itself and as a modifier describing the cooking method.

examples.japanese: {牛|ぎゅう}すじの{煮込|にこ}みが{好|す}きだ。
{今日|きょう}は{煮込|にこ}み{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}ろう。
{寒|さむ}い{日|ひ}は、{野菜|やさい}たっぷりの{煮込|にこ}みが{体|からだ}を{温|あたた}めてくれる。
examples.english: On cold days, a stew full of vegetables warms you up.

notes:
The noun form of {煮込|にこ}む (to simmer, to stew). Refers to any dish where ingredients are cooked slowly in liquid until tender and flavorful. A hearty comfort food category in Japanese cuisine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煮込|にこ}み{料理|りょうり} — stewed dish, slow-cooked cuisine
- {煮込|にこ}みうどん — udon noodles simmered in broth
- {煮込|にこ}みハンバーグ — hamburger steak simmered in sauce
- もつ{煮込|にこ}み — simmered offal (a popular izakaya dish)

CULTURAL NOTE:
もつ{煮込|にこ}み (offal stew) is a classic working-class dish often found at izakaya and street stalls. {煮込|にこ}みうどん is a winter favorite, especially in the Nagoya region where it is called {味噌|みそ}{煮込|にこ}みうどん.

RELATED WORDS:
- {煮込|にこ}む — to simmer, to stew (the verb form)
- {煮物|にもの} — simmered dishes in general; a broader category in Japanese home cooking
